field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Bind code, inputs and frozen contracts to the result.
field_principles.status: Terminal only after completion or a diagnosed external block.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Only incomplete own work can be partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True when verification uses the same correctness authority; separate implementations alone do not remove circularity.
